products.name: Precision Oncology Therapeutics Targeting the Chromatin Regulatory System
products.description: Small molecule drugs, including enzyme inhibitors and protein degraders, developed to selectively target genetically determined dependencies within the chromatin regulatory system for the treatment of various cancers. These therapeutics are produced via synthetic chemistry and delivered orally or via other formulations, requiring extensive preclinical and clinical development and regulatory approval.

products.name: Selective SMARCA2 Modulators (Inhibitors and Degraders)
products.description: Oral small molecule inhibitors and protein degraders specifically targeting SMARCA2 for the treatment of SMARCA4-mutated cancers, including non-small cell lung cancer and other solid tumors. These are developed using proprietary screening and medicinal chemistry, and are advanced through clinical trials in partnership with Eli Lilly.

products.name: Selective CBP Degraders
products.description: Small molecule protein degraders designed to selectively degrade CBP (CREB binding protein) for the treatment of EP300-mutated and CBP-dependent cancers, such as bladder, endometrial, colorectal, breast, gastric, and lung cancers. These are developed using high-throughput screening and structure-based optimization.

products.name: Selective EP300 Degraders
products.description: Small molecule protein degraders targeting EP300 for the treatment of EP300-dependent cancers and CBP-mutated cancers, including multiple myeloma, diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, acute myeloid leukemia, and myelodysplastic syndrome. Developed using proprietary chemical matter and validated in preclinical models.

products.name: Selective ARID1B Degraders
products.description: Small molecule protein degraders designed to selectively degrade ARID1B for the treatment of ARID1A-mutated cancers, such as endometrial, gastric, gastroesophageal junction, bladder, and non-small cell lung cancer. Developed using structure-based design and high-throughput screening.

products.name: Gene Traffic Control Platform-Based Drug Discovery Programs
products.description: Drug discovery and development programs leveraging the proprietary Gene Traffic Control platform to identify, validate, and optimize small molecule therapeutics targeting various components of the chromatin regulatory system for oncology and potentially other diseases. These programs use genomic and epigenomic tools, high-throughput screening, and AI-driven target identification.

products.name: Reinforcing Carbons
products.description: Manufactured carbon black particles used primarily as a rubber reinforcing agent in tires and industrial rubber products. Produced in large-scale, highly controlled manufacturing facilities using by-product feedstocks from petroleum refining and other industrial processes.

products.name: Engineered Elastomer Composites (E2C)
products.description: Composite materials combining reinforcing carbons and rubber, produced using a patented process to improve abrasion resistance and reduce fatigue in tires and high-wear rubber products. Manufactured at dedicated facilities and integrated into customers' existing production methods.

products.name: Specialty Carbons
products.description: High-purity carbon black products engineered for use in plastics, inks, coatings, adhesives, batteries, and electronics to impart color, conductivity, UV protection, and mechanical properties. Produced in specialized plants with controlled processes for particle morphology and surface treatment.

products.name: Specialty Compounds (Masterbatch and Conductive Compounds)
products.description: Formulated products combining specialty carbons with polymers and additives, used by plastic resin producers and converters for automotive, industrial, packaging, and electronics applications. Manufactured in dedicated facilities for ease of handling and dispersion.

products.name: Battery Materials (Conductive Additives and Fumed Alumina)
products.description: Materials including conductive carbons, carbon nanotubes, carbon nanostructures, and fumed alumina, used as additives in lithium-ion and advanced lead acid batteries to enhance conductivity, energy density, and cycle life. Produced in specialized facilities with high purity requirements.

products.name: Fumed Metal Oxides (Fumed Silica and Fumed Alumina)
products.description: Ultra-fine, high-purity particles used as reinforcing, thickening, abrasive, or anti-caking agents in adhesives, sealants, coatings, batteries, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals. Manufactured in dedicated plants using chlorosilane and aluminum chloride feedstocks.

products.name: Aerogel
products.description: Silica-based, high surface area, hydrophobic particles used for thermal insulation in building and construction, as well as specialty chemical applications. Produced in specialized manufacturing plants using silica sol or sodium silicate as raw materials.

products.name: Inkjet Colorants and Inks
products.description: Pigment-based black and color dispersions and inks for inkjet printing, produced using patented pigment surface modification and polymer encapsulation technologies. Used in office, graphic arts, and packaging printing applications.

products.name: EVOLVE Sustainable Solutions
products.description: A technology platform for developing sustainable reinforcing carbons and related products made with renewable or recovered materials, or using processes with reduced greenhouse gas emissions. Developed in collaboration with customers and technology partners, produced at industrial scale.

products.name: Co-generated Energy from Tailgas
products.description: Usable energy (steam or electricity) produced as a by-product of reinforcing carbons manufacturing, sold externally from energy centers at certain manufacturing sites.

products.name: Hotel Ownership and Leasing
products.description: The company owns and leases upscale, rooms-focused hotels, primarily under Marriott and Hilton brands, in urban and high-end suburban markets across the U.S. These hotels are operated by third-party management companies and generate revenue through guest room rentals and related services. The company acquires, develops, and disposes of hotel properties as part of its core business.

products.name: Silicone Gel-Filled Breast Implants (Motiva Implants)
products.description: Manufactured silicone gel-filled breast implants for breast augmentation and reconstruction, incorporating proprietary safety and aesthetic technologies such as SmoothSilk surface, ProgressiveGel, RFID microtransponder, and BluSeal barrier. Delivered via direct sales and distributors to clinics and hospitals globally.

products.name: Breast Tissue Expanders (Motiva Flora Tissue Expander)
products.description: Manufactured temporary implantable devices used to gradually expand breast tissue prior to permanent implant placement, featuring MRI compatibility and integrated RFID port. Sold to hospitals and clinics for use in reconstruction procedures.

products.name: Minimally Invasive Breast Augmentation Systems (Preservé and Mia Femtech)
products.description: Proprietary systems and tools for minimally invasive breast augmentation and mastopexy, including specialized implants (Ergonomix2 Diamond), surgical instruments, and procedural kits, enabling procedures under local anesthesia with smaller incisions and faster recovery. Delivered through certified surgeons and clinics.

products.name: Implantable RFID Microtransponder Platform (Qid and Zen)
products.description: Implantable RFID microtransponder devices and associated readers for unique device identification, traceability, and patient safety, integrated into breast implants and tissue expanders, and available for potential sale to other medical device companies.

products.name: Fluid Treatment and Pump Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells a variety of pumps and fluid treatment systems for residential, commercial, and industrial applications, including pressure vessels, membrane bioreactors, wastewater reuse systems, advanced membrane filtration, specialty valves, and agricultural spray nozzles. Products are physically manufactured and delivered through wholesale and retail distribution channels.

products.name: Water Treatment Products and Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells commercial and residential water treatment products and systems, including pressure tanks, control valves, activated carbon products, commercial ice machines, conventional filtration products, and point-of-entry and point-of-use water treatment systems. These are physically manufactured and distributed to residential and commercial customers for water filtration, softening, and foodservice applications.

products.name: Pool Equipment and Accessories
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells a complete line of energy-efficient residential and commercial pool equipment and accessories, including pumps, filters, heaters, lights, automatic controls, chlorinators, automatic cleaners, maintenance equipment, and pool accessories. Products are physically manufactured and distributed for pool maintenance, repair, renovation, and construction.

products.name: Cleaning Appliances
products.description: A range of small household cleaning appliances, primarily including vacuums and floorcare products, designed and engineered by SharkNinja and manufactured by third-party suppliers. These products are distributed globally under the Shark brand and require physical manufacturing, quality assurance, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Cooking and Beverage Appliances
products.description: Small kitchen appliances for cooking and beverage preparation, such as air fryers, pressure cookers, outdoor ovens, carbonation appliances, and related products, sold under the Ninja brand. These products are physically manufactured and distributed through retail and online channels.

products.name: Food Preparation Appliances
products.description: Appliances for food preparation, including blenders, food processors, and related kitchen systems, primarily under the Ninja brand. These products are physically manufactured and require engineering, design, and quality control.

products.name: Beauty Appliances
products.description: Small appliances for personal beauty and hair styling, such as hair dryers and styling tools, sold under the Shark brand. These products are physically manufactured and require compliance with safety and quality standards.

products.name: Home Environment Appliances
products.description: Appliances designed to improve the home environment, including air purifiers, fans, and coolers, sold under Shark and Ninja brands. These products are manufactured by third-party suppliers and distributed globally.

products.name: Outdoor Cooking Appliances
products.description: Outdoor cooking products such as propane grills, fire pits, and outdoor ovens, primarily under the Ninja brand. These are physically manufactured appliances distributed through retail and online channels.

products.name: Drinkware
products.description: Reusable drinkware products, such as bottles and cups, designed for beverage consumption and sold under SharkNinja brands. These are manufactured physical goods distributed through retail and online channels.

products.name: Skincare Appliances
products.description: Small appliances for skincare, such as facial treatment devices, sold under SharkNinja brands. These are manufactured products requiring compliance with health and safety standards.

products.name: Unified Communications as a Service (UCaaS)
products.description: A cloud-native platform (8x8 Work) that integrates business telephony, HD video meetings, team chat, SMS, and collaboration tools, delivered digitally and accessible globally for internal and external business communications.

products.name: Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS)
products.description: A cloud-based contact center solution (8x8 Contact Center) providing omnichannel customer engagement across voice, chat, email, SMS, and social channels, with embedded AI for analytics, routing, and agent assistance, delivered via a scalable, secure digital platform.

products.name: Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS)
products.description: Cloud-based programmable communications APIs enabling businesses to embed voice, SMS, messaging, and other digital channels directly into their applications and workflows, with global reach and integrated security, delivered as a digital service.

products.name: Digital Engagement Solutions for Customer-Facing Teams
products.description: A modular, cloud-based solution (8x8 Engage) that extends digital engagement and collaboration tools—including unified customer profiles, AI-powered summaries, and real-time insights—to non-traditional customer-facing employees such as sales and field service, delivered via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Microsoft Teams Integration Solutions
products.description: Integrated solutions that embed global telephony, customer engagement, and advanced analytics—including AI-driven transcription and sentiment analysis—directly into the Microsoft Teams interface, delivered as cloud-based add-ons.

products.name: Technology Partner Ecosystem Solutions
products.description: Curated, deeply integrated third-party solutions (e.g., Conversational AI, Analytics, Security, Workforce Management, CRM, ERP) delivered through the 8x8 platform, enabling customers to assemble customized customer experience workflows using a no-code approach.

products.name: Wireless Connectivity IP
products.description: Licensable hardware and software intellectual property for wireless communications, including Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Ultra-Wideband (UWB), cellular IoT, and 5G/5G-Advanced. Delivered as silicon-ready IP cores, subsystems, and software stacks for integration into customer ASICs, ASSPs, and SoCs. Requires deep R&D in wireless standards and is delivered digitally to semiconductor and OEM customers.

products.name: Sensing, Perception & Audio Processing IP
products.description: Licensable DSP cores and embedded software for sensor fusion, audio processing, spatial computing, and perception workloads. Enables customers to process data from cameras, microphones, IMUs, radar, and other sensors for applications like motion tracking, spatial audio, and multimodal sensor processing. Delivered as digital IP and software for integration into chips and devices.

products.name: AI Processing & Neural Network Acceleration IP
products.description: Licensable neural processing unit (NPU) architectures, AI-optimized DSPs, and software toolchains for on-device AI inference, including embedded and generative AI workloads. Delivered as digital IP cores and SDKs for integration into customer silicon, supporting applications from microcontrollers to automotive and industrial platforms.

products.name: Embedded Software Solutions for Audio, Sensing, and AI
products.description: Licensable embedded software stacks and SDKs for audio enhancement, spatial audio, sensor fusion, and AI model integration. Delivered as software products to OEMs and semiconductor customers to enable advanced features and accelerate time-to-market for smart devices.

products.name: Net Leased Retail Real Estate Leasing
products.description: The company owns, acquires, develops, and manages retail properties which are leased to tenants under long-term net lease agreements. These leases typically require tenants to pay rent and all property operating expenses, and the properties are physically developed or acquired by the company and then leased to external retail tenants.

products.name: Retail Property Development Services
products.description: The company develops retail properties, often as build-to-suit projects, managing all aspects of the development process including site selection, land acquisition, lease negotiation, due diligence, design, and construction, resulting in fee simple ownership upon completion. These services are provided to external tenants who become lessees of the developed properties.

products.name: Developer Funding Platform (DFP) Services
products.description: Through its Developer Funding Platform, the company collaborates with third-party developers or retailers by providing construction expertise and capital to facilitate the completion of in-process retail development projects, typically taking ownership of the property upon completion. This service supports external developers and retailers in completing their projects.

products.name: Retail Property Disposition Services
products.description: The company occasionally sells retail real estate assets and land parcels from its portfolio to external buyers, generating proceeds and potential gains from these dispositions. This involves the transfer of ownership of developed or acquired retail properties to third parties.

products.name: Playboy-Branded Consumer Products
products.description: A wide range of consumer products including apparel, accessories, beauty and grooming products, and sexual wellness items, produced and distributed globally through licensing agreements with third-party partners. These products leverage the Playboy brand and intellectual property and are sold via retail, e-commerce, and collaborations.

products.name: Luxury Lingerie and Intimacy Products (Honey Birdette)
products.description: Luxury lingerie, certain apparel, bedroom accessories, intimacy products, and other adult products sold directly to consumers online and through physical Honey Birdette stores in Australia, the United States, and the United Kingdom. The company manages inventory and fulfillment for these channels.

products.name: Playboy Digital Content and Subscriptions
products.description: Digital content and entertainment, including free and subscription-based offerings on playboy.com, as well as legacy digital platforms and content creator services (Playboy Club), distributed via web and television. As of 2025, these operations are primarily licensed to third parties but continue to generate revenue through licensing and direct digital offerings.

products.name: Playboy-Branded Digital Gaming and Casino Experiences
products.description: Digital casino and online gaming experiences, including real-money and social casino-style games, developed and operated by strategic partners under license using Playboy intellectual property. These are distributed through app stores and online platforms.

products.name: Playboy-Branded Hospitality and Nightlife Experiences
products.description: Hospitality venues, nightlife experiences, and events operated by third-party partners under license, including beer gardens, clubs, and other branded venues, primarily in international markets. These experiences leverage the Playboy brand and are managed by hospitality operators.

products.name: Playboy Magazine and Editorial Content
products.description: Print and digital magazine publishing, including the resumed Playboy magazine, which serves both as a brand marketing tool and a source of content and intellectual property for potential monetization. Distribution is primarily through digital and print channels.

products.name: Luxury and Upper Upscale Hotel Lodging
products.description: Ownership and leasing of uniquely positioned luxury and upper upscale hotels and resorts, primarily in the top 25 lodging markets and key leisure destinations in the U.S. These properties are physically owned, require significant capital investment, and are operated by third-party management companies under franchise or management agreements.

products.name: Beauty Products
products.description: A comprehensive line of premium-quality beauty solutions, including innovative skin care devices, cosmetics, and personal care products, developed through proprietary research and manufactured by third parties and subsidiaries. Distributed globally via direct selling and digital channels.

products.name: Wellness Products
products.description: A broad portfolio of nutritional supplements and wellness solutions, including vitamins, minerals, and functional foods, developed through research and quality manufacturing, and distributed globally under brands such as Pharmanex and ageLOC.

products.name: Beauty and Wellness Devices
products.description: Connected and data-enabled devices for beauty and wellness applications, such as facial cleansing, anti-aging, and personalized health assessment, manufactured using proprietary and licensed technologies and integrated with mobile applications for personalized consumer experiences.

products.name: Private-Label Dietary Supplement Manufacturing
products.description: Contract manufacturing of dietary supplements for third-party brands, leveraging in-house and subsidiary manufacturing facilities and expertise in formulation, quality control, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Personal Care and Functional Food Contract Manufacturing
products.description: Development and manufacturing of personal care products and functional foods for external clients, utilizing proprietary technologies and manufacturing subsidiaries to deliver custom formulations and packaging solutions.

products.name: Packaging Design and Sourcing Services
products.description: Consulting and provision of packaging design, development, and sourcing services for consumer products, offered through specialized subsidiaries to external customers.

products.name: Ingredient Technology Solutions
products.description: Manufacturing and supply of advanced ingredient technologies that enhance bioavailability and shelf stability for food, beverage, supplement, and personal care industries, provided to external clients.

products.name: Beauty Products via Digital and Retail Channels (Rhyz)
products.description: Sale of beauty products through digital and retail channels by Rhyz subsidiaries, leveraging proprietary brands and e-commerce platforms to reach consumers outside the core Nu Skin direct selling business.

products.name: DNA Assessment and Recommendation Technology
products.description: Provision of DNA-based assessment and personalized product recommendation technology for wellness and beauty applications, offered to external customers and partners.

products.name: Interventional Glaucoma Devices
products.description: Medical devices, including the OMNI Surgical System and SION Surgical Instrument, designed for use by ophthalmic surgeons to perform microinvasive glaucoma surgery (MIGS) procedures that reduce intraocular pressure in patients with primary open-angle glaucoma. These are single-use or manually operated devices manufactured by third parties and sold primarily to ambulatory surgery centers and hospital outpatient departments.

products.name: Interventional Dry Eye Devices
products.description: The TearCare System, a proprietary medical device platform including reusable hardware (SmartHub), disposable eyelid devices (SmartLids), and accessories, designed for use by eye care professionals to deliver localized heat therapy and facilitate removal of meibomian gland obstructions in patients with evaporative dry eye disease. The system is manufactured by third parties and sold to optometry and ophthalmology practices.

products.name: ETF and Exchange Traded Product Management Services
products.description: Management and advisory services for exchange traded funds (ETFs) and exchange traded products, including commodity, equity, and mixed index funds. Services include fund creation, administration, and ongoing management, primarily delivered through regulated financial entities and requiring significant financial and regulatory infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Bakery Products
products.description: Production and distribution of commercial-scale baked goods such as meat pies, sausage rolls, and patisserie cakes, manufactured in leased facilities and sold through grocery chains, convenience stores, and cafes in New Zealand.

products.name: Specialty Food Wrapper Printing
products.description: Flexographic printing of specialty wrappers for the food industry, primarily serving food manufacturers in New Zealand, including both internal and external customers. Production is based in a dedicated manufacturing facility.

products.name: Beauty and Personal Care Products
products.description: Formulation, packaging, and global distribution of vegan, non-toxic hair and skin care products under the Original Sprout brand, sold through online direct-to-consumer channels, wholesale distributors, salons, and retail stores. Production is outsourced to specialized manufacturers.

products.name: UK Asset Management and Financial Advisory Services
products.description: Provision of asset management and investment advisory services to clients in the United Kingdom, including wealth management and financial planning, delivered through regulated subsidiaries and earning revenue based on assets under management.

products.name: UK Fintech Mobile Banking Application
products.description: Development and operation of a digital mobile banking app in the UK, offering personal savings tools, high-yield savings accounts, and features such as Piggy Bank and Me2Me for account management, delivered via a proprietary software platform in partnership with a regulated bank.

products.name: (Former) Security Systems and Monitoring Services
products.description: Sales, installation, and support of electronic security systems including alarms, access controls, and fire monitoring panels for commercial and residential customers in Saskatchewan, Canada. Included recurring monitoring services through third-party partnerships. (Business sold July 2025.)

products.name: Smartphones
products.description: Foxx develops and sells affordable, high-performance smartphones under its own brand, manufactured through original design manufacturers and distributed via third-party distributors, major carriers, and e-commerce channels. The devices are physically produced, require regulatory certification, and are sold primarily in the U.S. market.

products.name: Tablets
products.description: Foxx produces and sells competitively priced tablets designed for diverse consumer needs, manufactured by original design manufacturers, and distributed through carriers, distributors, and e-commerce platforms. The tablets are physically manufactured, require regulatory certification, and are targeted at enhancing digital inclusion.

products.name: Wearable Devices
products.description: Foxx designs and sells wearable devices such as smartwatches and fitness trackers, including LTE-enabled kids smartwatches, developed in partnership with OEMs and distributed through e-commerce and third-party channels. These are physical products requiring hardware development, certification, and integration with Foxx’s IoT platform.

products.name: Smart Home Solutions
products.description: Foxx offers smart home products including water leak detectors and plans to expand into security cameras and home care software, integrating IoT connectivity, sensor technology, and mobile app development. These solutions are manufactured through partnerships and are distributed via retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: IoT Cloud Platform
products.description: Foxx provides a cloud-based IoT platform for device management, data analytics, and integration with third-party devices and applications. The platform is developed in-house, leverages AWS and other cloud providers, and is offered as a digital service to both Foxx device users and external partners.

products.name: IoT Modules
products.description: Foxx develops and sells hardware modules enabling connectivity (4G LTE, 5G, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, etc.) for IoT devices, targeting device manufacturers and integrators. These modules are physically produced and undergo lab testing and certification before market launch.

products.name: Automotive IoT Devices
products.description: Foxx is developing and plans to sell automotive IoT devices such as 4G LTE dashcams, jump starters, and trackers, which provide real-time data transfer, remote access, and fleet management capabilities. These are physical products integrating cellular connectivity and cloud features, targeted at both consumer and commercial markets.

products.name: App Installation and Distribution Service
products.description: Foxx provides a service to app developer partners by pre-installing their applications on Foxx mobile devices and facilitating distribution to end users. This is a digital service bundled with device sales, leveraging Foxx’s manufacturing and distribution network.

products.name: Restaurant Operations
products.description: Operation and franchising of casual dining restaurants under the Steak n Shake and Western Sizzlin brands, including company-operated, franchise partner, and traditional franchise units. Restaurants serve classic American menu items and require physical locations, in-person labor, and regulated food service infrastructure.

products.name: Property and Casualty Insurance and Reinsurance
products.description: Underwriting and selling property and casualty insurance products, including commercial truck, garage liability, commercial property, homeowners, and dwelling fire insurance, as well as reinsurance services. Products are delivered through direct response methods and insurance agents, requiring regulatory compliance and financial capital.

products.name: Oil and Gas Production
products.description: Operation of oil and natural gas properties and wells, primarily offshore in Louisiana and in the Permian Basin, involving physical extraction, processing, and sale of oil and gas commodities. Requires significant physical infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and capital investment.

products.name: Brand Licensing
products.description: Licensing of the Maxim brand and related intellectual property to third parties for use on products and media, generating royalty and licensing fee income. Involves management of trademarks and contractual agreements with licensees.

products.name: Agency Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (Agency RMBS)
products.description: Investments in residential mortgage-backed securities issued or guaranteed by U.S. government agencies or federally chartered corporations, secured by pools of residential mortgages. These are acquired and managed as financial assets, requiring significant capital and expertise in mortgage markets.

products.name: Agency Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (Agency CMBS)
products.description: Investments in commercial mortgage-backed securities issued or guaranteed by U.S. government agencies or federally chartered corporations, backed by pools of commercial mortgages. These are managed as financial assets and require expertise in commercial real estate finance.

products.name: Non-Agency Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (Non-Agency CMBS)
products.description: Investments in commercial mortgage-backed securities not guaranteed by government agencies, backed by commercial real estate loans. These require financial capital and risk management expertise due to higher credit risk.

products.name: Non-Agency Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (Non-Agency RMBS)
products.description: Investments in residential mortgage-backed securities not guaranteed by government agencies, backed by non-conforming residential mortgage loans. These require financial capital and credit risk analysis.

products.name: To-Be-Announced Securities Forward Contracts (TBAs)
products.description: Engagement in forward contracts to purchase or sell Agency RMBS at a future date, specifying price and terms but not the exact securities. This is a financial product requiring capital markets expertise and is used for investment and hedging.

products.name: Real Estate-Related Financing Arrangements (Unconsolidated Ventures)
products.description: Investments in real estate-related financing through unconsolidated ventures managed by affiliates, providing capital to real estate projects or assets. This involves financial structuring and partnership management.

products.name: U.S. Treasury Securities
products.description: Investments in U.S. Treasury securities as part of the overall portfolio, providing liquidity and risk management. These are standard financial instruments requiring capital allocation decisions.

products.name: Home Services Marketplace
products.description: A digital platform connecting consumers with local, pre-screened home professionals (Pros) for over 500 categories of home repair, maintenance, and improvement projects. Delivered via web and mobile applications, leveraging proprietary algorithms and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Pre-Priced Home Services Booking
products.description: A service allowing consumers to directly book and pay for pre-priced home services (such as assembly, installation, cleaning) through the Angi platform or select third-party retail partners, fulfilled by independent Pros. Delivered digitally and fulfilled in-person by Pros.

products.name: Lead Generation and Referrals for Home Professionals
products.description: Provision of consumer leads and referrals to approved home professionals (Pros), including full-priced leads, discounted leads via subscription, and double opt-in leads, delivered through digital platforms and proprietary algorithms.

products.name: Advertising and Directory Listings for Home Professionals
products.description: Advertising services and online directory listings for Pros, including business profile pages, mobile app presence, and inclusion in affiliated directories, to help Pros market their services to consumers. Delivered digitally via web and mobile platforms.

products.name: Membership Subscriptions for Consumers and Pros
products.description: Paid membership packages for both consumers and Pros, offering enhanced access to tools, resources, referrals, and exclusive content. Delivered digitally and managed via web and mobile applications.

products.name: International Home Services Marketplaces
products.description: Digital platforms in Canada and Europe (HomeStars, MyBuilder, MyHammer, Travaux, Werkspot) connecting consumers with local home professionals for various home services, operating under localized business models.

products.name: Home Services Content and Project Planning Tools
products.description: Provision of online content, project cost guides, ratings, reviews, and digital tools to assist consumers in researching, planning, and managing home projects. Delivered digitally via web and mobile platforms.

products.name: Hydroponic and Organic Gardening Products
products.description: A comprehensive range of products for indoor and outdoor hydroponic and organic gardening, including nutrients, additives, growing media, lighting, environmental control systems, and related supplies. These are sold through retail stores, commercial sales, wholesale distribution, and online platforms, and require physical distribution and specialized knowledge.

products.name: Proprietary Gardening Brands and Products
products.description: A portfolio of proprietary branded gardening products, such as Charcoir, Drip Hydro, Power Si, Ion lights, The Harvest Company, and Viagrow, developed and marketed for both commercial and home growers. These products are manufactured or sourced, branded, and distributed through multiple channels.

products.name: Customized Storage Solutions
products.description: Custom-designed storage solutions, including high-density mobile storage systems, static shelving, benching, racking, and accessories such as desks, lockers, and safes. These are delivered as turnkey projects with services like site surveys, floor plan design, capacity analysis, permitting, and installation, primarily for commercial, agricultural, and specialty markets.

products.name: New and Pre-Owned Recreational Boat Sales
products.description: Sale of new and pre-owned recreational boats, including fishing boats, pontoon boats, runabouts, wake/ski boats, yachts, and personal watercraft, through physical dealerships and online platforms. This involves inventory management, in-person and virtual sales, and delivery to customers.

products.name: Marine Parts and Accessories Sales
products.description: Manufacturing, assembly, and distribution of marine-related parts and accessories, including OEM and aftermarket products such as jack plates, bilge pumps, rigging parts, plumbing components, LED lighting, storage systems, electronics, safety products, and water sport accessories. Products are sold through dealerships, distribution centers, online marketplaces, and to OEMs, retailers, and consumers.

products.name: Boat Repair and Maintenance Services
products.description: Provision of repair and maintenance services for boats, including warranty and non-warranty work, at most dealership locations. Services are performed by trained technicians and include preventative maintenance, engine repairs, and installation of parts and accessories.

products.name: Finance and Insurance Products
products.description: Arrangement of boat financing and insurance products for customers purchasing new or pre-owned boats, including retail installment contracts, third-party extended service contracts, and property and casualty insurance. These services are offered at dealerships and online, generating fee income.

products.name: Boat Storage and Marina Services
products.description: Provision of indoor and outdoor boat storage, marina services including fueling and docking, and boat slip accommodations at select dealership and marina locations. These services are recurring and support customer engagement and retention.

products.name: Boat and Personal Watercraft Rentals
products.description: Rental of boats and personal watercraft at certain marina and dealership locations, with a small fleet maintained for short-term customer use. Rental boats are typically repurposed for pre-owned sales after one season.

products.name: Manufacturing and Distribution of Marine and Ancillary Maintenance Products
products.description: Manufacture, marketing, and distribution of branded and private label appearance, performance, and maintenance products for marine, automotive, power sports, recreational vehicle, home care, and outdoor power equipment markets. Includes custom blending, packaging, and patented chlorine dioxide-based disinfectant products.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Comprehensive suite of deposit products (checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit), digital banking solutions, consumer lending (including home equity lines of credit, mortgages, installment loans, credit cards), delivered through physical branches and digital channels. Requires regulated infrastructure, in-person and digital service, and financial capital.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Full-service relationship banking for businesses, including commercial lending (working capital, equipment, expansion, acquisition, CRE, C&D, C&I, agricultural), deposit and cash management, treasury management, and payment/card solutions. Delivered via local bankers, digital platforms, and physical branches; requires regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive wealth management, investment management, fiduciary services, retirement and employee benefits solutions, financial, estate and tax planning, and insurance planning for individuals, families, and businesses. Delivered through specialized advisors and digital platforms, requiring licensed professionals and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Government Banking Services
products.description: Banking services tailored to government entities, including deposit accounts for public funds, lending, and specialized treasury management solutions. Delivered through dedicated teams and digital platforms, requiring regulatory compliance and relationship management.

products.name: Treasury and Cash Management Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive treasury and cash management services for businesses and government clients, including payables (ACH, wire, cards, payroll), receivables (merchant services, lockbox, remote deposit), fraud management, and information reporting. Delivered via digital platforms and integrated with client systems.

products.name: Payment and Card Solutions
products.description: Commercial and consumer payment solutions, including debit cards, credit cards, commercial cards, prepaid cards, payroll cards, and merchant acquiring services. Delivered via physical cards and digital payment infrastructure, requiring regulatory compliance and technology investment.

products.name: Health Savings Account (HSA) Programs
products.description: Health Savings Account (HSA) administration and related banking services for individuals and employers, delivered through digital and branch channels. Requires specialized compliance and technology.

products.name: Thermal Polyaspartates (TPAs)
products.description: Manufactured water-soluble polymers produced via a thermal polymerizing process, optimized for various market verticals including oilfield, agriculture, irrigation, and cleaning products. Delivered as chemical additives for industrial and agricultural applications, often custom-formulated and distributed under multiple brands.

products.name: Nitrogen Conservation Products for Agriculture
products.description: Manufactured chemical products (e.g., SUN 27TM, N Savr 30TM) designed to inhibit nitrogen loss from fertilizers in agricultural fields, sold through distributors under company and private labels. Production involves chemical formulation and distribution to agricultural markets.

products.name: Food and Nutritional Materials
products.description: Custom-manufactured food and nutritional ingredients produced using specialized equipment for specific clients. Products are confidential and tailored to client specifications, with manufacturing based in company facilities.

products.name: HEATSAVR® Pool and Spa Energy Conservation Products
products.description: Chemical products and automated dispensers for swimming pools and spas that form a thin, transparent layer on water to reduce evaporation and energy loss. Manufactured using chemicals and plastics, with some production outsourced to third parties.

products.name: WATERSAVR® Water Evaporation Reduction Products
products.description: Granulated chemical products based on proprietary technology, applied to reservoirs, storage tanks, ponds, aqueducts, and irrigation ditches to reduce water evaporation. Manufactured by third parties and sold for agricultural, municipal, and turf care uses.

products.name: Dolls
products.description: A broad portfolio of dolls and related accessories, including flagship brands like Barbie, American Girl, Disney Princess, Disney Frozen, Monster High, Polly Pocket, and others. These products are physically manufactured and distributed globally, targeting children and adult collectors.

products.name: Vehicles
products.description: Die-cast vehicles, tracks, playsets, and related accessories under brands such as Hot Wheels, Matchbox, and Cars (Disney Pixar). These are physically manufactured toys appealing to children and collectors, distributed worldwide.

products.name: Infant, Toddler, and Preschool Toys
products.description: Toys and products for infants, toddlers, and preschoolers, including Fisher-Price, Little People, Thomas & Friends, and related baby gear. These are physically manufactured products designed for early childhood development and play.

products.name: Action Figures
products.description: Action figures and related toys based on both Mattel-owned and licensed entertainment franchises, including Masters of the Universe, Jurassic World, WWE, Toy Story, Star Wars, and others. These are physically manufactured toys distributed globally.

products.name: Building Sets
products.description: Construction and building playsets, including Mattel Brick Shop and MEGA Bloks, utilizing both owned and licensed IP. These are physically manufactured toys designed to foster creativity and development in children.

products.name: Games
products.description: Physical and digital games, including card games (UNO), board games (Pictionary, Skip-Bo, Phase 10, Blokus), and other classic and party games. These are manufactured as physical products and increasingly offered in digital formats.

products.name: Plush Toys
products.description: Plush toys associated with movie releases from licensed entertainment franchises and Mattel-owned IP. These are physically manufactured soft toys distributed globally.

products.name: Digital Games and Experiences
products.description: Mobile games, digital play experiences, and content developed through self-publishing, Mattel163 mobile games studio, licensing, and creator platforms. These are delivered digitally via mobile and online platforms.

products.name: Content and Media (Film, Television, Short-form)
products.description: Production and licensing of content for film, television, and short-form media based on Mattel's brands and IP. Delivered through partnerships with entertainment companies and digital platforms.

products.name: Consumer Products Licensing
products.description: Licensing of Mattel's trademarks and IP to third parties for use in consumer products, location-based entertainment, and publishing. This is a business-to-business service generating royalty revenue.

products.name: Real-Time Volumetric Imaging Sonar Systems (Echoscope® Series)
products.description: Proprietary real-time volumetric imaging sonar systems, including Echoscope®, Echoscope PIPE®, and Echoscope PIPE NANO Gen Series®, designed, developed, and manufactured in-house. These hardware and software solutions provide high-resolution 3D/4D/5D/6D imaging for underwater applications, used in commercial, defense, and autonomous vehicle markets.

products.name: Diver Augmented Vision Display (DAVD) System
products.description: A patented, integrated hardware and software solution for divers, featuring a head-up display (HUD) embedded in helmets or masks, providing real-time data, augmented reality, and communication capabilities. Manufactured and sold for defense and commercial diving markets, including both tethered and untethered variants.

products.name: Geophysical Survey Solutions (DA4G®, GeoSurvey®, Survey Engine®)
products.description: Hardware and software packages for acquisition and processing of sidescan sonar and sub-bottom profiler data, used for marine geophysical surveys. Developed and manufactured in-house, these solutions are sold to survey companies and oil & gas industries for data acquisition and interpretation.

products.name: Inertial Positioning and Attitude Measurement Systems (F280 Series®)
products.description: GNSS-aided inertial measurement systems providing accurate positioning, heading, pitch, roll, and yaw data at sea. These hardware solutions are manufactured and sold for integration with sonar systems or as standalone products for marine navigation and survey applications.

products.name: Digital Audio Communications Systems (Voice HUB_4)
products.description: Digital audio communication hardware and software systems designed for underwater applications, enabling high-quality voice and data transmission between divers and surface teams. Developed and manufactured in-house for commercial and defense diving operations.

products.name: Acoustic Sensors and Materials (Hydrophones, Transducers, Acoustic Materials)
products.description: Custom-designed acoustic sensors, including needle and membrane hydrophones, fibre-optic hydrophones, single element transducers, and passive acoustic materials. Manufactured and supplied primarily for medical imaging, non-destructive testing, defense, and underwater acoustics markets.

products.name: Automated Acoustic Measurement Systems
products.description: Custom automated measurement systems for ultrasonic and acoustic testing, designed and manufactured for precision measurement and calibration in medical, industrial, and defense applications. These systems are tailored to customer specifications.

products.name: Calibration and Measurement Services (ISO/IEC 17025 Accredited)
products.description: Accredited calibration and measurement services for ultrasonic and acoustic devices, including hydrophone calibration and ultrasonic power calibration. Services are performed in specialized facilities and are critical for regulated and high-risk applications in medical and defense sectors.

products.name: Defense Engineering Services (Embedded Solutions and Sub-Assemblies)
products.description: Custom engineering, prototyping, and manufacturing of embedded solutions and sub-assemblies for integration into mission-critical defense systems. Services include hardware and software design, manufacturing, repair, and upgrade for long-term defense programs, primarily as a subcontractor to prime defense contractors.

products.name: Residential Rental Properties
products.description: Ownership, management, and leasing of multifamily residential apartment units in Manhattan and Brooklyn, delivered through physical real estate assets and in-person property management services.

products.name: Commercial Rental Properties
products.description: Ownership, management, and leasing of office and retail space in commercial buildings in Manhattan and Brooklyn, delivered through physical real estate assets and in-person property management services.

products.name: Retail and Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provides a wide range of banking services including demand, savings, and time deposit accounts, as well as consumer, mortgage, and commercial loans, delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital channels such as internet and mobile banking.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Provides fiduciary and investment management services, including acting as trustee, guardian, or conservator, estate settlement, and agency for trustees, delivered through a dedicated wealth management division requiring specialized human expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Brokerage and Investment Products
products.description: Offers advisory services and a broad selection of investment products such as IRAs, mutual funds, annuities, 529 plans, life and long-term care insurance, and brokerage certificates of deposit, primarily through third-party providers and in-person advisors.

products.name: Title Insurance Services
products.description: Sells title insurance products through a joint venture, requiring regulatory compliance and coordination with real estate transactions, delivered via specialized staff and partnerships.

products.name: Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Acts as a broker for insurance sales, including various insurance products, through an investment in an insurance group serving member banks, leveraging third-party relationships and regulatory expertise.

products.name: Hemodialysis Concentrates
products.description: Manufactured liquid and dry, acid and bicarbonate concentrates used in hemodialysis treatment, delivered to dialysis clinics and hospitals. Production follows cGMP and AAMI guidelines at dedicated facilities, and products are diluted on-site to create dialysate for patient blood cleaning.

products.name: Bicarbonate Cartridges
products.description: Single-use, premium grade bicarbonate cartridges containing sodium bicarbonate concentrate powder, designed for use in compatible hemodialysis devices. Manufactured and packaged in disposable canisters for individual dialysis treatments.

products.name: Dry Acid Concentrate Mix Systems
products.description: 510(k) approved mixing systems manufactured for exclusive use with Rockwell's dry acid products, enabling clinics to mix acid concentrate on-site. These systems are produced at a dedicated facility and support cost and logistics efficiencies for dialysis providers.

products.name: Ancillary Hemodialysis Supplies
products.description: Distribution of essential ancillary products such as acetic acid cleaner, citric acid descaler, water softener salt pellets, and other supplies used by hemodialysis providers. These are sourced and supplied to select customers as part of a broader offering.

products.name: Water and Wastewater Treatment Infrastructure Construction
products.description: Designs, builds, expands, rehabilitates, and upgrades water and wastewater treatment infrastructure, including desalination plants, using advanced treatment technologies. Delivered through large-scale physical construction projects for public and private sector clients.

products.name: Water Resources Infrastructure Construction
products.description: Constructs, rehabilitates, and upgrades dams, reservoirs, water conveyance and storage systems, flood control systems, pump stations, and coastal protection infrastructure. Projects involve large-scale civil engineering and construction for water supply, hydroelectric power, and flood control.

products.name: Climate Resilience Infrastructure Construction
products.description: Builds and upgrades levees, flood walls, pump stations, and drainage systems to strengthen infrastructure against severe weather events and facilitate recovery. Delivered through heavy civil construction projects for public sector clients.

products.name: Transportation and Mobility Infrastructure Construction
products.description: Constructs mass transit systems (light rail, bus rapid transit), autonomous transportation solutions, and implements intelligent transportation technologies. Projects require large-scale civil and systems engineering for public transit authorities and municipalities.

products.name: Energy Transition and Mission Critical Infrastructure Construction
products.description: Modifies and constructs facilities to support electric vehicle fleets, implements renewable energy components, and supports data center construction. Delivered through specialized construction and engineering services for public and private clients.

products.name: Electrical and Power Distribution Solutions
products.description: Provides specialized, high-performance electrical and power distribution construction services, including low and medium voltage systems, commissioning, and operations and maintenance. Delivered through a dedicated subsidiary for infrastructure and industrial clients.

products.name: Moving Truck and Trailer Rentals
products.description: Rental of U-Haul branded trucks and trailers for do-it-yourself household and commercial moving, available through a large network of company-operated stores and independent dealers. Equipment is designed and manufactured for ease of use and fuel efficiency, and is rented via physical locations and digital platforms.

products.name: Self-Storage Unit Rentals
products.description: Rental of fixed-location self-storage units in a variety of sizes, featuring security measures and climate control at many locations, for storage of household and commercial goods. Units are available at company-operated facilities and through a network of affiliates.

products.name: Portable Moving and Storage Units (U-Box)
products.description: Rental of portable U-Box moving and storage units, which can be delivered to customer locations, filled, and then stored at customer sites or U-Haul facilities, with transportation provided by customers or company personnel.

products.name: Moving Supplies and Packing Materials
products.description: Sale of U-Haul branded moving boxes, tape, packing materials, specialty boxes, security locks, and related supplies, available at retail locations and online for do-it-yourself movers.

products.name: Towing Equipment and Hitch Installation
products.description: Sale and installation of hitches and towing systems, as well as rental of towing accessories such as auto transports, tow dollies, and related equipment, for both U-Haul and personal vehicles.

products.name: Propane Refilling Services
products.description: Refilling of propane cylinders and alternative fuel vehicles at U-Haul locations, operated by trained and certified personnel, forming one of North America's largest propane dispensing networks.

products.name: Moving Help Marketplace
products.description: Online marketplace connecting customers with independent service providers for packing, loading, unloading, cleaning, and related moving services, facilitated through U-Haul’s website and app.

products.name: Self-Storage Property Management and Affiliate Services
products.description: Management of self-storage properties owned by others and provision of reservation and technology services to independent storage businesses through the U-Haul Storage Affiliates program.

products.name: Moving and Storage Protection Packages
products.description: Sale of insurance and protection packages (Safemove, Safetow, Safestor, Safehaul, Safemove Plus, Safetrip) providing damage waivers, cargo protection, liability, and roadside assistance for moving and storage customers.

products.name: Property and Casualty Insurance
products.description: Provision of property and casualty insurance products, including loss adjusting and claims handling, primarily related to U-Haul moving and storage activities, underwritten by Repwest and ARCOA subsidiaries.

products.name: Life and Health Insurance
products.description: Sale of life insurance, Medicare supplement insurance, annuities, and related products to the senior market, provided through the Oxford Life Insurance subsidiary.

products.name: Analog and Mixed-Signal Semiconductor Solutions
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells integrated analog and mixed-signal semiconductor products, including RF, analog, and digital components, for wireless connectivity across applications such as smartphones, tablets, wearables, automotive, industrial, medical, and infrastructure. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to OEMs and other customers.

products.name: RF Front-End Modules and Components
products.description: Provides highly integrated RF front-end modules and discrete components (amplifiers, filters, switches, tuners, etc.) for wireless devices and infrastructure, enabling high-performance signal transmission and reception. These are manufactured semiconductor products delivered to device makers and network equipment providers.

products.name: Automotive Semiconductor Solutions
products.description: Develops and supplies semiconductor products for automotive applications, including power isolation chips, connectivity modules (4G/5G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GPS), and infotainment system components. These are manufactured and sold to automotive OEMs and suppliers.

products.name: Industrial and Power Management Semiconductor Products
products.description: Manufactures and sells analog and mixed-signal semiconductor devices for industrial automation, motor control, power supply, solar inverters, and energy management, including DC/DC converters, digital power isolators, and voltage regulators. Products are physically produced and supplied to industrial customers.

products.name: Timing and Precision Clock Solutions
products.description: Designs and sells timing devices such as clock generators, oscillators, jitter attenuators, and buffers for use in data centers, optical networking, wireless base stations, industrial, and automotive applications. These are manufactured semiconductor products delivered to OEMs and infrastructure providers.

products.name: Wireless Connectivity Solutions for IoT and Smart Home
products.description: Provides integrated semiconductor solutions enabling wireless connectivity (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee, LoRa, Thread, etc.) for IoT devices, smart home products, and consumer electronics. These are manufactured chips and modules sold to device manufacturers.
